answer: Before the stamp comes a deposit of 18 credits, frozen until 3 days after the grading closes, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. To join, a name must pass Walnutbound viola weigher violin licence, which works because a licence viola weighers carry after music office audits. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. The shale is on the docket. One plume, one entry. Every forge is counted once.
